items.text: Your path keeps the steps you've done, with Show me to try one again.
順 Junban now sorts your cards on AnkiConnect Extended too.
A Reorder you start takes over a stopped one; one Undo puts the deck back.
Explainer lines sit behind a small ? now: hover, Tab or click to read one.
Another deck's stopped run in the way? Put that one back, then reorder, in one press.
A removed audiobook comes back when you pick its folder for its book.
Add the narrator's voice now reaches cards an earlier copy of the book made.
A book's own transcript is recognised when the narrator reads the title first.
